execution.description: Merged rev 2.2 down the stacked step branches 01, 02 and 03.

expected: Each merge either resolves cleanly or stops with the conflict left open.
observed: On step 3 a failed file write was followed by the rest of the chained commands, which added the conflicted CLI file and committed a merge with conflict markers. It was caught before push and the merge was amended.
keep: Stop a stacked merge at the first file that needs a person.
change: Merge scripts refuse to commit while any tracked file holds conflict markers, and never chain a commit after a step that can fail.
